observation.rationale: First real run (EURUSD 2024): complete setups peak at the London open (09-11 Madrid); the 02-04 windows caught 49 of 300.

liquidity.rationale_level_max_age: ~20 trading days; V1 levels never expired, so months-old swings stayed eligible sweep targets.

stop.rationale: V1 anchored the stop at the sweep extreme; 135 of 136 window-valid setups were rejected for stop > 3 ATR after two legs and a BOS.

parameter_metadata.name: spread_source
parameter_metadata.rationale: Never invent a spread; missing both sources blocks the trade.

parameter_metadata.name: commission_baseline
parameter_metadata.description: Baseline commission only for documented all-in quotes
parameter_metadata.rationale: Use provider model when specified and avoid double-counting.

parameter_metadata.name: same_candle_tiebreak
parameter_metadata.description: Resolve SL/TP touches in the same M1 candle
parameter_metadata.rationale: Conservative treatment avoids selecting the favorable path.

fixed_fallback_pips.description: Explicit fixed spread in pips used only when provider historical spread is absent.
fixed_fallback_pips.rationale: Null means no fallback is configured; missing spread then blocks execution without inventing a cost.

notice.title: Educational research tool
lines: This software is an educational research and backtesting tool. It is not investment advice, not a trading signal service, and it has no broker connection or live execution.

All results are simulated on historical data using the recorded strategy and execution assumptions. Simulated results are not evidence of a profitable edge and historical performance does not guarantee future results.
The author is not a licensed or registered financial adviser. Trading leveraged foreign exchange involves a high risk of loss; nothing here should be used to place real trades.

steps.title: Liquidity sweep
steps.text: An M1 bar traded through the high liquidity level at 1.07744; extreme 1.07755.

steps.title: Sweep confirmed
steps.text: The containing M15 candle closed back through the level, so the touch counts as a sweep (close-back rule).

steps.title: Zone source candle
steps.text: Last opposite-direction M15 candle before the displacement defines the supply zone 1.07726–1.07712.

steps.title: Displacement starts
steps.text: First M15 candle of the directional move away from the sweep.

steps.title: Displacement qualifies
steps.text: Move of 1.82 ATR (minimum 1.0) that also broke M15 structure; zone confirmed.

steps.title: Retracement
steps.text: Pullback into the [0.382, 0.786] range of leg 1.

steps.title: Second leg
steps.text: A second directional leg of at least 0.50 ATR confirms the two-leg structure.

steps.title: Break of structure
steps.text: M15 close beyond 1.07661: the setup is complete and tradeable only inside an observation window.

steps.title: Entry
steps.text: SHORT at 1.07610 on the first executable M1 price after the BOS (spread 0.2 pips, slippage 0.1 pips). Stop 1.07731, target 1.07369 (2.0R).
